text:
So excited to see this being released!

I've been playing with it quite a bit over the past few weeks and it's absolutely amazing; I encourage you to try it as soon as possible. Absolute ship by @matiNotFound 🫲🫱

We built https://vgpu.sh to ship shaders on https://vercel.com. Now it's open source.

▪︎ Minimal agent-first WebGPU library
▪︎ Run in the browser or headless Node.js
▪︎ Render in CPU sandboxes and CI tests
▪︎ Create reusable .wgsl modules
